description: Free. Records the result of work you performed under a claim from once_key_claim. Every later claim of that action_key returns 'duplicate' along with this result, which is what lets another agent continue without repeating the side effect. Always call this after the work succeeds — a claim with no recorded result leaves every other agent unable to learn what happened. Completion is final and cannot be overwritten. This tool is free; no payment is required.

namespace.description: Isolation scope used when the key was claimed

namespace_token.description: One-time token issued by the first call that claimed this namespace. Required for every later call.

result.description: Any JSON value describing the outcome, up to 16 KB serialized. Store large payloads elsewhere and record a reference.

ttl.description: How long to retain the result, in seconds (default 86400)

name: once_key_complete

action_key.description: The key whose outcome was recorded

expires_at.description: When the recorded result is discarded

has_result.description: Distinguishes a recorded null result from no result at all

result.description: The stored result, replayed to later claimants.

title: Record the outcome of a claimed action
